request.prompt:
Deliverable: landscape flat educational infographic for a Chinese AI engineering article.
Primary request: explain Jev's three atomic question primitives and what each returns.
Composition: large title at top, three equal cards below. Card one coral: "Choice — 选项", with a small probability bar chart and an icon for selecting one option. Card two teal: "Score — 评分", with a horizontal ordered scale and one marker. Card three orange: "Noul — 布尔", with a yes/no probability gauge. A full-width footer card reads "统一返回：decision + probability + confidence".
Style and medium: flat technical editorial infographic, warm paper background, crisp ink outlines, hand-drawn small accents, coral / teal / orange palette, clean spacing, no photorealism.
Text (exact): Allowed readable text only: "三个原子原语：Choice / Score / Noul", "Choice — 选项", "Score — 评分", "Noul — 布尔", "概率分布", "有序刻度", "真假概率", and "统一返回：decision + probability + confidence". Render each exactly once. All JSON, numbers, axes, code, and secondary annotations must be blank abstract placeholders.
Avoid: extra words, duplicated labels, misspellings, crowded layout, watermark.
